opening.argument: The presentation promotes purchasing Strong tokens and activating paid nodes through specific recurring-return claims and instructions. The speaker ties one node to an approximately $1,500 cost and states that “fifty days you will earn ten coins,” then presents the strategy as generating “the compound effect” and “residual income.” The invitation is operational as well as financial: viewers are told to keep Strong tokens in a wallet and that they “can buy a strong token on multiple exchanges.” The speaker further assures viewers, “I see it continuously rising ups and continuously paying out this phenomenal amount of income.” Together with the displayed node-rewards interface, listed nodes, and controls to obtain Strong or create a node, these statements solicit participation in a paid node-income scheme built on promised growth and payouts.
